newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini says tax harmonisation vital for EMU.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini says tax harmonisation vital for EMU.

text.p: Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini said on Friday that tax harmonisation with the European Union would be essential for the full success of European economic and monetary union (EMU).
"Besides being monetary, the union is also economic," Dini said in an address to the parliamentary commissions for foreign affairs and European Union affairs.

"A currency that is the same for everyone will eliminate what its commonly called competitive devaluations. But unless tax treatment is not harmonised there is the risk of falling into a pirate-style war of competitive tax reductions in order to attract money and investments," he said.
"Even with the euro, the single market would remain a mirage," Dini said.
Dini said there was now "a general conviction" in Europe that the single currency would be launched in January, 1999.
